name: Momentum Group Limited
source: Momentum Group Limited audited consolidated financial statements for the year ended 30 June 2026, statement of financial position page 37 and the net asset value table in the results announcement, printed in R millions and stored here as absolute ZAR. Total assets 917,887; total liabilities 882,969; total equity 34,918 (equity attributable to owners 34,521 plus non-controlling interests 397); cash and cash equivalents 39,594. Total assets less total liabilities equals total equity exactly. The group is an insurer and its statement prints no current and non-current subtotals, so those four rows stay empty rather than being guessed.
